name: amethyst/distill
description: Asset pipeline system for game engines that reads artist-friendly source formats, processes them into engine-ready formats, handles dependency tracking, hot-reloading, and asset packing for shipping.
score_rationale: Well-architected Rust asset pipeline with 373 stars addressing the full production pipeline use case, though development is tied to the now-inactive Amethyst engine project.
summary: Rust asset pipeline with dependency tracking, hot-reload, and engine conversion
